result.question: Why did Uzziah live separately until death?

readings.support: was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation

readings.answer: Because the LORD had afflicted him.
readings.support: He lived in isolation, leprous | because the LORD had afflicted him

assessments.reason: Verse 26:21 explicitly links his isolation to being a leper: “was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation,” matching the key.

“Because the LORD had afflicted him” in v.20 explains his immediate exit, but that affliction was leprosy which persisted and led to lifelong isolation, so it’s an imprecise yet causally compatible paraphrase.
